regions.today: Starting off cloudy with patchy outbreaks of light rain and drizzle, along with some patches of mist. Drier conditions will develop through the morning with some sunny spells breaking through in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees, warmest further south and east, with light to moderate southwesterly winds easing through the day.
regions.tonight: While there will be outbreaks of rain and drizzle further north in the province, it should stay mostly dry further south, with occasional clear spells too. There will be some mist and fog patches too. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees, with light variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly cloudy with patchy outbreaks of rain and drizzle. A cool day for some with highest temperatures of 11 to 18 degrees, from north to south, with light to moderate northerly breezes.
